description: Runner receipt signer trust. No signer is provisioned: enabled=false and public_keys empty. While no signer is provisioned, runner manifests cannot certify capability evidence; every capability that requires runner trust stays unevidenced and its conformance rows remain partial/open. Provisioning is out-of-band: the private signing key lives only in out-of-tree, root-owned forced-command infrastructure; this repository carries only this config and the public keys.
